prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic minimalist studio fashion portrait of one original approved adult woman against a neutral light-gray backdrop.
prompt.main_subject: Original approved adult woman with short wavy hair, round eyeglasses, soft natural makeup, realistic skin texture, calm confident expression and gaze slightly away from camera. She wears a bold red jacket over a white T-shirt.
composition_elements: Head-and-shoulders or mid-length centered portrait with shallow background separation.
Neutral light-gray studio backdrop and uncluttered composition.
Preserve red jacket construction, white layer, eyeglasses, hair movement, natural highlights and modern editorial balance.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft diffused key light with gentle natural shadows, subtle highlights on facial structure and glasses, and even neutral exposure.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic 2:3 portrait, 85mm lens at f/2.8, sharp face, hair, jacket and glasses detail, realistic pores, subtle grain, no text or watermark.
